subject: Request: Trial extension and sandbox credits — SignalPath integration blocker
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@signalpath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Integration is blocked — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We started an internal integration spike this morning and hit a blocker almost immediately: our SSO flow and the Redwood SDK aren't agreeing on assertion attributes. The devs see a 401 from the inference gateway when the session exchange happens; we attached the minimal server log and a screenshot of the failed request.

This blocks our end-to-end demo slated for 11/10. We are asking for a 30-day trial extension and an allocation of additional sandbox credits (we expect ~200k tokens) so we can keep experimenting while we troubleshoot. If possible, we'd also like a technical point-of-contact from Redwood engineering to join a short troubleshooting call — this looks like a config mismatch and we could move fast with an engineering pair.

Appreciate any help; happy to hop on a call today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tom Hayes
CTO, SignalPath
Attachments: error-log-20271101.txt (text), sso-screenshot-20271101.png (image)

Tom —

Thanks for the quick heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry you're blocked; we want to get you unblocked before your demo. High-level next steps from my side:

2) I'm looping in our engineering lead (Dev) to triage the logs and join a short screen-share.
3) Can you confirm the exact SDK version and whether you're using our container or the hosted endpoint? That will speed triage.

Would 4pm PT tomorrow for a 30-minute troubleshooting call work? If so, we'll send a calendar invite with the join link.

I'll follow up internally and reply with authorization and credit details once I have engineering's assessment.

Best,

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration is blocked — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Thanks Marissa — happy to help. Quick technical read: based on the logs Tom sent, this looks like a SAML assertion attribute/NameID mismatch between SignalPath's IdP and our gateway. Concretely: their AssertionConsumerService is sending a transient NameID while our hosted auth expects a persistent NameID in the saml:Subject. Workarounds:

- Short term: configure the IdP to emit persistent NameID (recommended) OR alter their SDK auth call to include the raw assertion (we can accept that as a temporary compat layer)
- I can join the troubleshooting call tomorrow. Should take 30–45m to confirm and either fix or provide a clear engineering patch.

Office hours: I can commit 60–90 minutes this week and next (two sessions). If Tom confirms a call at 4pm PT tomorrow, I'll be there.

Dev
Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference

Tom / Julia —

Appreciate your patience while we triaged this. Good news: we've approved a 30‑day trial extension for SignalPath (addendum attached) and allocated 250,000 sandbox tokens to your account to cover the integration work. Attached is the extension authorization (PDF) and a CSV that details the credit allocation.

We've scheduled a troubleshooting session with our engineering lead Dev Patel and Karthik for 2027-11-17 at 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent separately. Dev will walk through the SAML assertion behavior and we should have a path to resolution in that call.

Next steps for you: please reply with the SDK version and whether you're hitting our hosted endpoint or a private deployment; also confirm if you can rotate the IdP NameID to persistent (Dev will advise on the call).

DocuSign: I'll send an electronic addendum for signature — link will come from DocuSign (we'll copy the HubSpot ticket in the envelope). HubSpot: SIG-4721 has been updated to reflect the extension and credit allocation.

If anything changes before tomorrow, ping me. We're committed to getting you unblocked for the demo.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
